definitions.explanation: Lacking refinement or good taste; coarse in manner or speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧{下品|げひん}な⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わないで→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't use such vulgar words.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{下品|げひん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.english: Laughing loudly is sometimes considered vulgar.

notes:
{下品|げひん} describes something vulgar or lacking in refinement. It can describe speech, behavior, appearance, or taste.

Forms:
- {下品|げひん}な + noun: {下品|げひん}な⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ (vulgar words)
- {下品|げひん}に + verb: {下品|げひん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{振|ふ}る{舞|ま}う→振る舞う：04233_furumau⟧ (to behave vulgarly)

Antonym: ⟦{上品|じょうひん}→上品：03081_jouhin⟧ (elegant, refined)

Similar words:
- ⟦{卑|いや}しい→卑しい：16203_iyashii⟧ - base, low, mean (stronger negative connotation)
- ⟦{粗野|そや}→粗野：13833_soya⟧ - rough, uncouth
- ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - lacking class/refinement
